ein.description: The Employer Identification Number the notice assigns, exactly as printed in the header block, e.g. '12-3456789'

notice.description: The notice's own identifiers, from the header block at the top right of page 1

notice_number.description: The number of this notice, exactly as printed, e.g. 'CP 575 A'

notice_date.description: The date of this notice, exactly as printed in the page 1 header block, without reformatting

form.description: The application form the notice responds to, e.g. 'SS-4'

revision.description: The notice's form revision printed above the tear-off stub, e.g. 'CP 575 A (Rev. 7-2007)'

entity.description: The business the EIN was assigned to, as named in the mailing address block

legal_name.description: The entity's legal name, the first line of the mailing address block

address.description: The entity's street, city, state and ZIP from the mailing address block, as one line

name_control.description: The name control associated with the EIN, stated in the body text (usually four characters)

required_filings.description: The forms the entity must file and their due dates, from the list after 'you must file the following forms by the dates shown'

form.description: The form to be filed, e.g. 'Form 1120'

due_date.description: The date it is due, exactly as printed

issuer.description: The issuing office and how to contact it

agency.description: The issuing agency, e.g. 'Internal Revenue Service'

office_address.description: The issuing office's city, state and ZIP from the letterhead, as one line

assistance_phone.description: The phone number given for assistance in the header block
